title: The repository control has an exact classical BFV boundary reduction

classical_bfv.boundary_phase_space: Completed triangular Cauchy data (A,E,phi,pi) on T3 with canonical symplectic form, restricted to the neutral trivial-bundle sector
classical_bfv.moment_map: The based gauge Hamiltonian moment map is G=div E-e Im<Qphi,pi> in H^-1_0
classical_bfv.bfv_charge: Omega_BFV=integral_T3 c_0 G and {Omega_BFV,Omega_BFV}=0 for the abelian based gauge algebra
classical_bfv.constraint_resolution: K1415--K1416 identify G as a global split coordinate and contract the Koszul--Tate complex onto functions on G^-1(0)
classical_bfv.gauge_resolution: K1417 contracts the longitudinal/ghost doublet and identifies based degree-zero BRST cohomology with functions on the constrained Coulomb slice
classical_bfv.residual_completion: Full classical gauge reduction is obtained by taking residual compact U(1) invariants on the proper orbit-type stratified quotient classified by K1418
classical_bfv.degree_zero_result: On the declared cylindrical algebra, classical BFV H^0 is the algebra of gauge-invariant functions on the neutral Gauss quotient
classical_bfv.positivity: K1348's nonnegative Hamiltonian descends to the reduced stratified space and is nonzero on explicit physical classical classes
classical_bfv.boundary: Classical BFV H^0 is an observable algebra, not a quantized state Hilbert space. No representation, completion, Born pairing, interacting quantum BRST operator or positive GU physical Hilbert cohomology is constructed
